decision: Retain the independently verified original full-loop baseline. Implement versioned durable availability binding and guarded recovery next; original study deployment remains unchanged. Full service adoption and live promotion remain unqualified.
falsifier: A source/raw/index mismatch, omitted original attempt, changed per-source budget or reservation, false full-grid assertion, failure of independent archived reproduction, or disagreement under actual process kill/restart invalidates or updates the affected claim.
hypothesis: Durable service availability enforcement must preserve each actual frozen producer runtime and remain effective when its store recovers orphan raw files.
limitations: This is an original-runtime baseline; service admission and return evidence are not integrated before ingestion.
Synthetic constant-price public candle, funding and metadata responses with deterministic logical clocks; no latency, wall-alarm or financial benefit claim.
Stores and runtime objects are reconstructed inside each isolated source interpreter. Exception-injected crashes do not qualify actual OS kill/restart, power loss or CLI/manifest lifecycle.
Native peer fixtures are empty and refreshed by simulated external actors; production shared IP headroom and actual venue charges remain unmeasured.
The original schema families differ: oldest quarter allows added tables; newer quarter and native reject them. No implicit in-place migration is qualified.
Trusted local hashes and clocks do not defend against a compromised local writer.
Coverage measures six new research modules only, not the original producer code or whole trading system.
